blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.
blocks.zh: 隐喻是人类认知的一个关键方面. 因此,我们想了解它是如何在大语言模型中体现的,以及如何加以控制。 我们使用机械解释技术来识别一系列涵盖不同架构和大小的LLMs中的因果子空间. 我们显示,我们能够在发言的不同部分指导产出的分类工作。 我们还能够引导输出完成生成任务,表明这些技术可以用来控制LLM输出的隐喻性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Metaphor is an essential part of everyday human language use. Sources such as Steen et al. (2010) ; Shutova (2010) show that metaphor pervades language. Furthermore, metaphor forms a basis for the fundamental creativity and concept formation that we are capable of Lakoff and Johnson (2008) . Large language models such as Llama 3 Grattafiori et al. (2024) have some capacity to understand and produce metaphorical language, although whether they are up to human performance is debated Chakrabarty et al. (2021) ; Stowe et al. (2022) ; Ichien et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 隐喻是人类日常语言使用中的一个基本部分. 来源如Steen等人(2010年); Shutova (2010年) 显示该比喻渗透语言. 此外,比喻构成了我们拉科夫和约翰逊(2008年)有能力的基本创造力和概念形成的基础。 Llama 3 Grattafiori等人(2024年)等大型语言模型有一定的理解和产生比喻语言的能力,尽管他们是否达到人类的性能被辩论为Chakrabarty等人(2021年);Stowe等人(2022年);Ichien等人(2024年).

blocks.en: One way to understand the capacities of large language models is via mechanistic interpretability : by examining the internals of large language models via, for example, the Logit Lens 1 1 1 https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/AcKRB8wDpdaN6v6ru/interpreting-gpt-the-logit-lens , causal interventions Meng et al. (2022) , or circuit discovery Conmy et al. (2023) . Sharkey et al. (2025) provides a thorough review and discussion of open problems in the area. One recent paper, Marks and Tegmark (2024) , argued that Llama models exhibited a ‘truth direction’ at particular layers, which was common to different datasets, and that the models’ output could be steered by causal intervention on this layer.
blocks.zh: 通过Logit Lens 1 1 1 https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/AcKRB8wDpdaN6v6ru/interpretting-gpt-the-logit-lens,因果干预,通过对大语言模型的内部解释来理解大语言模型的能力的一种方法. Meng等人(2022年),或电路发现 Conmy等人(2023年). Sharkey等人(2025年)对该地区的开放问题进行了透彻的审查和讨论。 最近一篇名为Marks和Tegmark(2024年)的论文认为,Llama模型在特定的层次上展现了一种 " 真实的方向 " ,这在不同的数据集中是常见的,而且模型的输出可以通过在这一层次上的因果干预来引导。

blocks.en: Finding such a direction for metaphor would give insight into how models represent metaphor. This has been investigated to some extent Boisson et al. (2024) but not yet at the mechanistic level. Finding this direction could also provide a useful ‘dial’ that could potentially be used to steer the metaphoricity or literalness of output text, using techniques from e.g. Li et al. (2023) . In this paper, we use activation patching Meng et al. (2022) and distributed alignment search Geiger et al. (2024) to find a ‘metaphoricity direction’ or subspace within a given model. We show that these directions are causally effective: we are able to change the output of models in classification tasks for metaphor identification and interpretation; and in a generation task we are able to steer the model towards more metaphorical output.
blocks.zh: 为比喻找到这样一个方向,将使人们深入了解模型如何代表比喻。 这一点在一定程度上受到Boisson等人(2024年)的调查,但还没有在机械层面上得到调查. 找到这个方向还可以提供一种有用的 " 拨号 " ,可以用来利用例如来自的技术来引导产出文本的隐喻性或文字性。 李等 (2023) (中文(简体) ). 在本文中,我们使用激活补丁Meng等人(2022年)和分布式对齐搜索Geiger等人(2024年)在给定的模型中找到一个"元化方向"或子空间. 我们表明,这些方向是因果有效的:我们能够改变分类任务中模型的输出,用于比喻识别和解释;在一代人的任务中,我们能够引导模型走向更比喻的输出.

blocks.en: • We identify directions and subspaces for metaphoricity in a range of models, and show that these have some causal effect. • We show that these directions are somewhat consistent across different metaphor datasets. • We test seven models from four different model families (Gemma Riviere et al. blocks.en: 2 Background and Related work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和相关工作

blocks.en:
In metaphor processing, research has focussed on two main tasks: metaphor identification , that is, identifying whether a word is metaphorical, and metaphor interpretation , that is, identifying the meaning of a metaphorical utterance. Work in using LLMs for metaphor identification include Fuoli et al. (2026) ; Reimann and Scheffler (2025) . On the metaphor interpretation side, there has been a range of work showing that modern LLMs have relatively strong performance at understanding metaphor, especially when fine-tuned Ichien et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2022b) .
Since metaphor is a key part of human language, we would like to understand how LLMs interpret and identify metaphor.
blocks.zh:
在比喻处理中,研究集中于两个主要任务:比喻识别,即识别一个词是否是比喻,以及比喻解释,即识别比喻言论的含义. 使用LLMs进行比喻识别的工作包括Fuoli等人(2026年);Reimann和Scheffler(2025年). 在比喻解释方面,有一系列工作显示现代LLMs在理解比喻方面有相对强大的性能,特别是微调Ichien等人(2024);刘等人(2022b).
由于比喻是人类语言的关键部分,我们希望了解LLMs如何解释和识别比喻.

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability techniques attempt to understand and affect the output of large language models by inspecting their internal representations, for example by looking at the vectors of activations produced at each layer of the model Meng et al. (2022) ; Marks and Tegmark (2024) . A common technique is to then causally intervene on these representations. This means that we examine how a model’s output changes when we alter its internal representations, for example by activation patching , introduced in Meng et al. (2022) ; that is, we save the activations for one input, and patch these into the activations for another input, examining which layers and tokens affect the output.
blocks.zh: 机械解析技术试图通过检查其内部表现来理解并影响大语言模型的输出,例如通过查看模型Meng等人(2022年)的每一层产生的激活载体;Marks和Tegmark(2024年). 一个常见的办法是对这些表述进行因果干预。 这意味着,当我们改变其内部表达方式时,当我们通过激活补丁(例如,在Meng等人(2022年)中引入),来检查一个模型的输出是如何变化的;也就是说,我们保存一个输入的激活,并将其补入另一个输入的激活,检查哪些层和符号影响输出。

blocks.en: In Marks and Tegmark (2024) , the authors use activation patching to find a combination of layer and token input that represents a concept of truth in a language model.
blocks.zh: 在Marks和Tegmark (2024)中,作者使用激活补丁来寻找层和符号输入的组合,代表语言模型中的真理概念.

blocks.en: Geiger et al. (2024) is a method for finding causal concepts in model activations, based on the assumption that full-vector activations may be polysemantic, i.e. may be activated for different concepts. The method has been used in existing benchmarks Mueller et al. (2025) for causal variable localization, and compared to other methods (SAEs, PCA, full-vector), DAS has been shown to find concepts that achieve superior causal performance. In this paper, we use DAS to find a causal concept of metaphoricity in the model’s residual stream, and compare the performance of steering using DAS with the existing mass-mean steering used by Marks and Tegmark (2024) .
blocks.zh: Geiger等人(2024年)是在模型激活中找到因果概念的一种方法,其依据的假设是全载体激活可能是多语义的,即可能为不同概念激活. 该方法已经用于现有的基准Mueller等人(2025年),用于因果可变本地化,与其他方法(SAEs,PCA,全载体)相比,DAS被证明能够找到能实现优异因果性能的概念. 在本文中,我们用DAS在模型的剩余流中找到一个比喻性的因果概念,并将使用DAS的引导性能与Marks和Tegmark(2024)使用的现有质量-平均值引导进行比较.

blocks.en: Controlling the style of LLM generated text is also an active area of research. Techniques used include training a separate model Liu et al. (2022a) , or prompt-based style control such as in Liu et al. (2024) . Relatedly, Li et al. (2023) alter the truthfulness of generated text via inference-time interventions.
blocks.zh: 控制LLM生成文本的风格也是一个活跃的研究领域. 所使用的技术包括培训一个单独的模型Liu等人(2022a),或者刘等人(2024)等即时的样式控制。 与此相关, Li等人(2023年)通过推论时间发言改变生成文本的真实性。

blocks.en: Metaphor identification, interpretation, and generation are key aspects of language use. So far, in LLMs, these abilities have mostly been investigated by looking at behavioural outputs. In this paper, we use activation patching and distributed alignment search to investigate firstly whether metaphorical and literal sentences are linearly separable in activation space, secondly whether we can steer models towards literal or metaphoric output, and lastly whether the steering vectors are common to different datasets. We control the metaphoricity of generated output using the inference-time intervention technique introduced by Li et al. (2023) . To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to control the metaphoricity of LLM output via intervention on the activations, rather than via prompting or building an external model.
blocks.zh: 隐喻识别、解释和生成是语言使用的关键方面。 迄今为止,在法学硕士课程中,这些能力主要是通过研究行为产出来调查的。 在本论文中,我们使用激活补丁和分布式对齐搜索,首先调查比喻和字面句子在激活空间中是否可线性分离,其次调查我们是否能够引导模型向文字输出或比喻输出,最后调查方向矢量是否与不同的数据集常见. 我们利用李等人(2023年)引进的推论时间干预技术来控制产出的隐喻性。 据我们所知,这是第一次试图通过干预激活来控制LLM输出的隐喻性,而不是通过推动或建立外部模型来控制.

blocks.en: 3 Datasets and Tasks
blocks.zh: 3 数据集和任务

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use three datasets covering two different parts of speech (nouns and adjectives) 2 2 2 We initially also used a verb dataset, however model performance on this dataset was not sufficiently high to probe with interpretability techniques. . Using mechanistic interpretability techniques requires that models are able to perform to a high standard on the task, and the structure of the dataset also needs to be fairly controlled. We therefore use relatively simply structured datasets. Following Marks and Tegmark (2024) , we use datasets with the following properties: 1) each sentence contains exactly one metaphorical target word; 2) sentences are short and structurally simple; 3) within each dataset, sentences have the same syntactic structure.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个数据集,涵盖语音的两个不同部分(名词和形容词) 2 2 2 我们最初还使用动词数据集,但该数据集的模型性能不够高,无法用可解释技术进行探测。 使用机械解析技术要求模型能够执行高标准的任务,数据集的结构也需要得到公平的控制. 因此,我们使用相对简单的结构化数据集。 继Marks和Tegmark(2024年)之后,我们使用具有以下属性的数据集: 1)每个句子都包含一个确切的比喻目标词;2)句子短而结构简单;3)在每个数据集中,句子具有相同的合成结构.

blocks.en: We use the following three datasets. Examples of sentences with metaphorical nouns and adjectives are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用以下三个数据集。 带有比喻名词和形容词的句子例子见表1 .

blocks.en: Table 1: Example sentences with metaphorically used nouns and adjectives. In example sentences, metaphorical target words are coloured blue.
blocks.zh: 表1:带有比喻使用的名词和形容词的示例句子. 举例来说,比喻性的目标词是彩色的蓝色.

blocks.en: We start from the small training set of Fig-QA Liu et al. (2022b) , which contains 200 human-written creative metaphors. Each example is paired with one correct rephrase and one incorrect rephrase in a Winograd-style format. Every two metaphor examples form a pair representing the meaning of a particular rephrase.
blocks.zh: 我们从Fig-QA Liu et al.(2022b)的小型训练集开始,包含200个人文创作比喻. 每个例子都配以一个正确的重写,和一个错误的重写,以威诺格勒风格的形式进行. 每两个比喻例子组成一对,代表特定重写的意义.

blocks.en: We first remove idioms, multi-clause descriptions, and long narrative sentences (e.g., “The painting has the creativity of Rembrandt and Picasso getting their paintings married” ). We then use ChatGPT OpenAI (2025) to rewrite the remaining examples into short, direct metaphors with the parallel structure “The noun 1 is (a/an) noun 2 ” . For example, the original sentence “The bear was the size of a whale after eating a smaller whale” is simplified to “The bear is a whale” . In each sentence, noun 2 metaphorically describes noun 1 . We manually verify that each sentence is grammatically correct and preserves the original metaphorical mappings. The final dataset contains 130 sentence tuples. In the rest of the paper we refer to this dataset as NOUN .
blocks.zh: 我们首先删除平话、多语种描述和长篇叙事句子(例如,“这幅画具有伦勃朗和毕加索结婚的创造力”。 然后,我们用ChatGPT OpenAI(2025年)将其余的例子改写成短而直接的比喻,与平行的结构“名词1是(a/an)名词2......”。 例如,最初的句子“熊在吃较小的鲸鱼后是鲸鱼的大小”被简化为“熊是鲸鱼”。 在每一句中,名词2暗喻地描述了名词1. 我们手动核实每个句子在语法上是正确的,并保留了原始的比喻映射. 最终数据集包含130句 tu. 本文其余部分将本数据集称为NOUN。

blocks.en:
We use the ADJ+N metaphor/literal dataset proposed by Tsvetkov et al. (2014) . The test set contains 100 adjective–noun pairs with both literal and metaphorical usages.
We modify this dataset to have a sentence format using the template “The N is ADJ.” In this dataset, the adjective carries the metaphorical meaning and modifies the noun. In the remainder of this paper, we refer to this dataset as ADJ .
blocks.zh:
我们使用茨韦特科夫等人提出的ADJ+N比喻/文学数据集(2014年)。 测试集包含100个形容词–名词配对,兼具文字和比喻的用法.
我们使用“N是ADJ”模板修改此数据集,使其具有句子格式。 在这个数据集中,形容词带有比喻意义并修改名词. 在本文件的其余部分,我们把这一数据集称为ADJ。

blocks.en: We also use the dataset by Gutiérrez et al. (2016) for DAS training, steering prediction and steering generation. The dataset consists of adjective-noun pairs across 8 different domains (clarity, depth, light, strength, substance, taste, temperature, texture). Each sample is labelled literal (e.g. “warm coffee”) or metaphorical (e.g. “warm welcome”). We evaluate on n=100 per steering direction from the held-out set not used for training DAS. In the remainder of this paper we refer to this dataset as DOM .
blocks.zh: 我们还使用Gutiérrez等人的数据集(2016年)进行DAS培训、指导预测和引导生成。 数据集包括跨越8个不同域的形容词-名词对(classity, 深度, 光, 强度, 实质, 味道, 温度, 纹理). 每个样本都标注为文字(例如“温咖啡”)或隐喻(例如“热烈欢迎”)。 我们按未用于培训DAS的被搁置的每套方向进行n=100的评估。 在本文的其余部分,我们把这一数据集称为DOM。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Identifying areas encoding metaphoricity
blocks.zh: 4.1 识别区域编码隐喻性

blocks.en: For each of the datasets and tasks described above, we use one of two techniques designed to isolate the part of the model used to encode metaphoricity. For the identification and interpretation tasks across NOUN , ADJ , and DOM , we use activation patching . For DOM and for the generation task, we also use distributed alignment search (DAS) to identify a linear subspace encoding metaphoricity. We use the mass-mean probe from Marks and Tegmark (2024) and the learned DAS subspaces to steer model output in the identification and interpretation tasks, requiring single-token output. Finally, we use the mass-mean probe and DAS subspaces to steer generation over multiple tokens, finding that it is possible to steer models towards more metaphorical or more literal output.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our results show that there are clear directions and subspaces associated with metaphoricity across a range of models and datasets (Figure 2 and Figures 5 , 6 in the Appendix). We are able to train DAS matrices which effectively alter output on a classification task (Table 3 ), and we see that training a global metaphor subspace is more effective than training domain-specific subspaces (Table 4 ), indicating that we have learnt a general concept of metaphor. These directions are moreover causally effective: using the mass-mean probe we are able to steer output in classification tasks, and this steering is more effective than steering using the direction identified by logistic regression (Table 5 ). We do note that the NIE values are somewhat lower than in Marks and Tegmark (2024) , however, it is also the case that metaphor identification and interpretation is a more difficult task than judging truth and falsity. We also see that there are higher NIEs steering from literal to metaphor than vice-versa. Creating a literal meaning from a metaphorical meaning is perhaps conceptually more difficult: warm coffee can readily be interpreted metaphorically via personification of the coffee, whereas warm welcome is more difficult to interpret literally.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,在一系列模型和数据集中存在与隐喻性有关的明确方向和子空间(附录中的图2和图5、图6)。 我们能够培训DAS矩阵,有效地改变分类任务的产出(表3),而且我们看到,培训一个全球比喻子空间比培训特定域子空间(表4)更有效,这表明我们学到了一个比喻的一般概念。 此外,这些方向还具有因果效力:利用质量-平均值探测器,我们能够在分类任务中引导产出,而这种引导比利用后勤回归所确定的方向进行引导更为有效(表5)。 我们确实注意到,NIE值比Marks和Tegmark(2024年)要低一些,但是,比喻识别和解释比判断真相和伪造更困难。 我们还看到,从字面到比喻,有比反面更高的NIE方向。 从比喻意义中创造字面意义在概念上也许比较困难:温咖啡可以通过咖啡的个性化来方便地解释,而热情欢迎则比较难以从字面上解释.

blocks.en: We further steer generation to more metaphorical output. In Table 7 , we see that the mass-mean probes are generally more effective than DAS steering, although this differs across model. Example generations are given in Table 8 . In future work, this technique could be developed to give a way of controlling the metaphoricity of generated output in a more direct way than prompting.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步引导一代人进行更隐喻的输出。 在表7中,我们看到,质量-平均探测器一般比DAS制导更有效,尽管这在不同的模型中有所不同. 例代数见表8。 在今后的工作中,可以开发这种技术,以提供一种比催化更直接的方式来控制生成产出的隐喻性.

blocks.en: We acknowledge that IIA scores are moderate and variable, and indeed this does imply that a proportion of the metaphoricity information is captured elsewhere. We note however, that previous work which has used DAS for locating concepts in model activation achieve similar scores (see e.g. Mueller et al. (2025) ). Achieving a perfect IIA score is not necessarily achievable in practice Geiger et al. (2024) , and this is a limitation of using DAS for concept-finding.
blocks.zh: 我们承认国际投资协定的得分是中度和可变的,这确实意味着在别处捕捉到一部分隐喻信息。 然而,我们注意到,以往使用DAS在模型激活中定位概念的工作取得了类似的分数(例如见DAS)。 Mueller等人(2025年))。 实现完美的国际投资协定得分在实际操作中未必能够实现Geiger等人(2024年),这是使用DAS进行概念调查的限制.

blocks.en: On the basis of Table 4 , we concluded that the DAS matrix trained on all domains captures a general concept of metaphoricity, as evidenced by its stronger transfer IIA results compared to the results achieved with its domain-specific counterpart. One confound could be the training data size: Compared to the domain-specific matrices trained on n samples, the global DAS matrix is trained on those and all the training samples from all other domains . As a control, we train a matched-n global DAS matrix. This matrix trained on the number of samples in each domain corresponding to the number of samples from the smallest training domain ( n = 255 n=255 ). We see in Appendix Table 15 that for Gemma 2 9B, training a matched-n global DAS matrix still achieves a better or equal transfer IIA score in 6/8 transfer domains.
blocks.zh: 根据表4,我们的结论是,在所有领域接受过培训的DAS矩阵抓住了一个隐喻性的一般概念,其证明是,与特定领域的对应方相比,转让国际投资协定的成果更为有力。 一个困惑是培训数据的规模: 与接受N类样本培训的特定域矩阵相比,全球DAS矩阵则接受来自所有其他领域的这些和所有培训样本的培训。 作为一个控制器,我们训练一个匹配的DAS全球矩阵. 这个矩阵培训了每个域的样本数量,与最小的训练域的样本数量相对应(n=255n=255). 附录表15显示,对Gemma 2 9B来说,培训一个匹配的DAS全球矩阵在6/8转让领域仍然能取得更好的或平等的IIA转让分数。

blocks.en:
For our generation experiment, we carried out a human validation of the LLM-as-judge. For the Gemma 9B model outputs, one of the authors of this paper has annotated 15% (100 items) as either metaphor, literal, or incorrect (nonsensical or incorrect output). Raw agreement is 0.79, Cohen’s kappa is 0.60, indicating moderate to substantial agreement. This indicates that the judge annotations are mostly reliable. This suggests that the concept we have isolated in the classification task is at least partially sufficient to flip free-form generation.
However, generally, we do achieve substantially lower IIA scores for the generation task compared to the classification task. Our DAS concept allows us to steer model classification to a moderately high degree, but this effect is less amplified for generation, and requires that we scale this signal by α = 5 \alpha=5 . There can be different reasons for this. It is possible that the metaphoricity concept we isolate in the classification task is functionally adapted to this task. The model could have another metaphoricity concept located in a different position adapted for generation. On the other hand, the fact that the concept has some meaning-steering effect suggests that we have captured a common concept of metaphoricity, at least partially.
blocks.zh:
为了我们这一代人的实验,我们进行了LLM-as-judge的人类验证. 对于Gemma 9B模型输出,本文的一位作者将15%(100项)作为比喻,字面,或者不正确(非感官或不正确的输出)附加注释. 原始协议为0.79美元,科恩的卡帕为0.60美元,表明有中度或实质性协议。 这表明法官的说明大多是可靠的。 这表明我们在分类任务中孤立的概念至少部分足以翻转自由形式生成.
然而,总的来说,我们确实实现了与分类任务相比,生成任务的国际投资协定分数要低得多。 我们的DAS概念允许我们将模型分类引导到中等高度,但这种效果在生成时放大得较少,并且要求我们用α=5\α=5来放大这个信号. 这样做可能有不同的原因。 我们在分类任务中孤立的隐喻概念有可能在功能上适应这项任务. 该模型可能具有另一个隐喻概念,位于适合一代人的不同位置. 另一方面,这一概念具有某种意义探索效应这一事实表明,我们捕捉到一个共同的隐喻概念,至少是部分的.

blocks.en: Further, we employed a controlled, templated setup for measuring metaphoricity in LLMs. We made this choice to effectively isolate the parts of the prompt that have a causal effect on the output. The structured sentence patterns allowed us to localize causal effects to specific token positions. Therefore, we deliberately did not test representations of metaphoricity in a more naturalistic context (e.g. poems), limiting the external validity of our findings.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们采用了一种可控的、模板化的设定,用于衡量LLMs中的比喻性。 我们做出了这一选择,以有效隔离对输出有因果影响的提示部分. 结构化的句子模式使我们能够将因果效应本地化到特定的象征位置. 因此,我们故意没有在一个更自然的环境下(如诗)检验隐喻性的表现,限制了我们结论的外部有效性.

blocks.en: 6.1 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6.1 结论

blocks.en: We have given evidence that metaphoricity is encoded as an interpretable direction in a variety of LLMs, illustrated as linear separability in PCA plots. We intervene on model activations and show that these directions are causally effective in changing model outputs in both classification and generation tasks. Future work in this area could extend to other aspects of writing style: at present, much work is based in prompting, and these techniques may give more control over style modifications.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了证据表明,隐喻性被编码为各种有限责任条款的可解释方向,在常设仲裁法院的地块中被说明为线性分离性。 我们介入模型激活,并表明这些方向在改变分类和生成任务的模型产出方面因果有效. 这一领域的未来工作可以扩展到写作风格的其他方面:目前,很多工作都以促动为主,这些技巧可能会对风格修改给予更多的控制.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Risks
blocks.zh: 7 限制和风险

blocks.en: • This work is carried out only on English metaphor. Linear separability and interpretable directions could be very different in other languages. • Mechanistic interpretability work requires very controlled settings and datasets, whereas metaphor can extend across multiple sentences, paragraphs, and discourse. The datasets we use are therefore only very simplistic uses of metaphor. More complex metaphor use is an area for future research. • We cannot carry out our experiments on the most highly performing closed models, since they do not have open weights, and computational resources would preclude this. • Risks In its present form, risks resulting from this work are fairly low. However, model steering techniques can potentially be risky. It is possible to steer towards undesirable as well as desirable behaviour.
blocks.zh: • 支助 这项工作只在英语比喻上进行. 线性分隔和可解释方向在其他语言中可能有很大的不同. · 机械解释工作需要非常受控制的设置和数据集,而比喻可以跨越多个句子、段落和论述。 因此,我们使用的数据集只是比喻的简单化用途。 更为复杂的比喻使用是未来研究的一个领域。 我们不能对性能最强的封闭模型进行实验,因为这些模型没有开放式的权重,计算资源将排除这种情况。 • 支助 风险 这项工作目前的风险相当低。 然而,模型引导技术可能具有风险。 有可能转向不良和可取的行为。

blocks.zh: J.4 提示格式

blocks.en:
All models use the same plain-continuation meaning-format prompt with five hardcoded
few-shot examples demonstrating free-form meaning descriptions (no classification
labels). The test query asks for the meaning of the adjective in context: The welcome was warm. The meaning of ’warm’ is: affectionate and emotionally inviting. The lamp was bright. The meaning of ’bright’ is: emitting a strong, clear light. The novel was deep. The meaning of ’deep’ is: intellectually complex and rich in meaning. The stone was smooth. The meaning of ’smooth’ is: having an even surface with no roughness. The defeat was bitter. The meaning of ’bitter’ is: painful, hard to accept, and leaving resentment. The [noun] was [adj]. The meaning of ’[adj]’ is:
